bounded_native.inputs: Plain owner-validated C-order canonical Boolean ndarray, rank 2, 1..192 in each dimension. Optional exact same-shape Boolean mask. Ordinary bool return_distance.
bounded_native.rng: Explicit nonnegative Python integer, exact PCG64 bit generator or exact NumPy Generator with PCG64. Genuine NumPy default_rng and permutation preserve caller state and tie ranks.
bounded_native.distance: Genuine SciPy ndimage EDT on the masked foreground, with stock all-foreground behavior. SciPy is optional; a missing or replaced provider invokes established compatibility.
bounded_native.native: C++ prepares the canonical masked foreground, validates provider buffers, derives fixed original corner scores, orders by distance then corner score then unique seeded rank, and uses the canonical 512-entry table for the single ordered pass.
bounded_native.outputs: Independent owning writable C Boolean skeleton and optionally separate owning writable C float64 distance. NumPy restores original Boolean values outside mask; returned distance remains that of masked foreground.
bounded_native.remaining: Seedless/default entropy, other RNGs, numeric and alternative ndarray descriptors/layouts, empty/rank/error controls and replacement providers are compatibility routes. Distinguish provider work and the serial native topology.
bounded_native.threading: Serial native topology in normal and forced-scalar modes.

timing.boundary: Complete public call from fixed allocated inputs, with independent per-call deterministic integer seed. Include optional EDT copy, RNG, provider work and output allocation.
